title: Exploration action
description: One constrained action the LLM proposes during the Phase B exploration loop. The model emits DATA validated against this schema; deterministic code validates it against scope + the action deny-list and only then executes it (LLM safety boundary, D8). The model never emits code. See docs/junior_engineer/seeded_session_exploration_design.md.

action.description: What to do. 'stop' ends the loop (no unexplored, in-scope, non-destructive branches left).

values.description: submit_form only: field name -> value for fields the observation lists as `inferable`. Each value must match the operator's declared shape; any other field is refused.

reason.description: Why this action (e.g. 'unexplored authenticated branch off dashboard').
